follow-up time: From estimated date of conception to 3 months postpartum
outcome: Acute peripheral arterial events (aortic dissection, carotid artery dissection, vertebral artery dissection, and ruptured renoviseral aneurysms)
cohort: All women who gave birth between 1998 and 2020 within a multicenter health care system, excluding those aged <18 or >50 years
finding: Pregnancy, especially when complicated by preeclampsia, is associated with an increased risk of acute peripheral arterial events.
